compliance.summary: The GoGloby section presents the company as a generative-AI deployment and workflow-design provider, rather than a staffing and recruiting agency. It also promotes unsupported timelines, credentials, performance claims, and legacy tools that should be corrected or removed.

llm_problems.title: AI implementation positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity; Glossary §1
llm_problems.issue: The section presents GoGloby as a provider that applies and deploys generative AI workflows, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency.
llm_problems.fix: Rework these passages to describe GoGloby's recruiting or staffing services instead of AI implementation and workflow design.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: GoGloby helps finance organisations apply generative AI as a governed workflow capability rather than a standalone tool.
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby as applying AI workflows for finance organisations, not recruiting or staffing engineers.

locations.quote: GoGloby helps finance teams introduce generative AI into real operating workflows
locations.reason: This says GoGloby introduces generative AI into client workflows, an implementation service not in the approved company description.

locations.quote: GoGloby helps structure generative AI workflows
locations.reason: This offers workflow structuring as GoGloby's work rather than describing its engineer staffing or recruiting services.

locations.quote: GoGloby helps organisations keep generative AI inside controlled environments
locations.reason: This presents GoGloby as deploying AI within client environments, rather than supplying recruiting or staffing services.
